BrochureContent.Content:
Rare opportunity not to be missed to acquire a prominent landmark property for sale on O'Connell Street in Ballymote town in Co Sligo. 

Versatile mixed-use development with commercial and residential elements, situated on a high-profile corner site with extensive street frontage onto the main street in the thriving county town of Ballymote. The entire property consists of two retail units; three residential properties; three exceptionally large outbuildings, two courtyards and three gardens.

Seldom does the opportunity to acquire such a large versatile site within a central town location come to market. The fact that this property occupies a corner site and has two separate gated vehicular access points enabling rear access from the side road are particularly appealing. Due to the unique and large footprint of the overall site, this property provides great potential for further development or redevelopment subject to planning permission.

The mixed use zoning is designed to promote the development of a dynamic mix of uses able to create and sustain viable town and village centres. Commercial (including retail), residential, leisure, community and office.

The property is located in the centre of Ballymote town and close to all amenities including the train station, shops, schools, creches and sports facilities. Ballymote is located a short drive from Sligo town, Sligo University Hospital and Sligo ATU. There are numerous daily bus and train connections to Sligo and Dublin and Knock airport is a short 30 minutes' drive away.
